scope_details.acquisition: No new checkpoint download is needed. Reuse only the previously acquired exact public artifact after this scoped approval and independent digest/size recheck; zero cost.
scope_details.experiment: Ticket 32 only: one frozen ResNet-18 configuration across corrected reference folds 0, 1 and 2; CPU-only.
scope_details.held_out_data: Held-out inputs and outcomes are for feature prediction/evaluation only; no fitting, adaptation, calibration or selection may use them.
scope_details.image_data: Do not download, access or use ImageNet source images.
scope_details.model_use: Keep the pretrained encoder frozen. Fit each fold head and any fitted transform independently on only that fold training partition.
scope_details.processing: Local/offline execution through cluster1-cpu Slurm; no runtime network or GPU; no external spend.
scope_details.reuse_and_sharing: Reuse identity-matched frozen features only within this three-fold comparison. No reuse outside Ticket 32, external sharing, mirroring or publication.
